jobDescription:
Company Overview

Banking industry company seeking skilled developers for cloud-based application development with focus on AWS and Node.js technologies.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Node.js Developer with experience in designing, developing, and deploying cloud-based applications and services. The role involves working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP, collaborating with cross-functional teams including architects, product managers, and other developers to create robust and efficient solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and implement highly scalable, secure, and fault-tolerant applications and services on AWS using Node.js
  • Develop cloud-native applications utilizing AWS services like EC2, S3, Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway
  • Manage and optimize AWS cloud infrastructure using AWS tools and services
  • Automate deployment processes using CI/CD pipelines with services like AWS CodePipeline, Jenkins, and Docker
  • Design and develop microservices-based architectures using Node.js and AWS Lambda for serverless solutions
  • Collaborate on the design and integration of RESTful APIs
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior developers
  • Monitor application performance and troubleshoot issues in production environments
  • Optimize serverless applications and cloud resources for efficiency and cost-effectiveness
  • Implement security best practices for cloud infrastructure and applications
  • Create and maintain detailed technical documentation for code, processes, and architectures

Requirements

  • 0-1 years of experience
  • Strong experience in Node.JS development
  • Experience with AWS services including Lambda, API Gateway, Redshift
  • Full stack development capabilities
  • UI development experience using Angular
  • Knowledge of microservices architecture
  • Experience with RESTful API development and integration

Mandatory Requirements

  • Banking experience Must
  • Strong experience in Node.JS
  • Experience with AWS Lambda, API Gateway, Redshift
  • Full stack Developer experience
  • B.Tech/B.E. in Any Specialization
  • Experience in UI development using Angular

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience with Python or Java
  • DevOps practices knowledge
  • Cloud technology trends awareness
  • Any Postgraduate degree

Additional Information

Role: Search Engineer | Industry Type: Banking | Employment Type: Full Time, Permanent | Role Category: Software Development | Work Mode: Hybrid | Locations: Hyderabad, Chennai
